title: Certify v0.12.1: erratum to the certified demagnetization-tensor reference tables — the gold-value anchor claim corrected from containment to agreement
description: Erratum release for v0.12.0 (certified demagnetization-tensor reference tables). As first released, the paper's numerical-anchor sentence asserted that the sixteen 50-digit Maple check values recorded in OOMMF's demagcoef.cc lie inside the certified enclosures. That assertion is false, and the release's own build log had already recorded why: the enclosures are roughly 77 digits tight, so a 50-digit value lies outside them in general — a direct test shows fifteen of the sixteen outside, the exact zero being the only exception. The correct statement, unchanged from v0.12.0 and unaffected by this erratum, is that all sixteen gold values agree with the enclosure midpoints to at least 49.6 digits, which is the right test at the gold values' own precision. Every certified enclosure, the checker, the certificate, the digit-loss brackets and the crossover results are unchanged; only the prose claim is corrected, with a dated erratum footnote in the note. Computations carried out with Claude (Anthropic), directed by the author.
